id.description: Same as the listing's directory name.

category.description: dApps: app, defi, staking, rwa, nft, game, virtual-world, governance, bridge. Tools: wallet, explorer, analytics, monitoring (validator and node alerting), developer-tools, infrastructure (RPC, indexers, relayers).

chains.description: Only in shared/<id>/: two or more Explorer chain slugs from chains.json. A listing under chains/<chain>/ takes its chain from the folder and has no chains field.

description.description: One or two sentences, from the project's own material.

appUrl.description: The product itself, not its marketing page. Required unless status is sunset.

coverPosition.description: CSS object-position for the 16:9 crop of the cover.

explorer.description: Links into Kynraze Explorer pages. The Explorer resolves these; there is no free URL here.

address.description: Required for validator (operator address) and account.

topic.description: Required for analytics, e.g. staking or districts.

maintainers.description: GitHub handles who can approve changes to this listing.
